name: Lustration: A Detective Story
summary:
A noir mystery game blending detective work and resource management, where every lead costs you something.

A routine murder lands on Detective Elizabeth Pine's desk. Pull on the threads, and watch it unravel into a conspiracy surrounding death itself, one that reaches into the Between, where the dead wait to cross over.

Her work. Her relationships. Her grip on what's real. Pine can't hold onto it all. What will she be willing to sacrifice?
